entities.name: Wolf
entities.description: A creature type for large, mostly nocturnal predatory canids that hunt in packs and exist on many planes.

entities.name: Werewolf
entities.description: Humans with the ability to change into wolves.

entities.name: Witchstalker
entities.description: A type of multi-legged wolf drawn to magic, found on Arcavios and Eldraine, which feeds on magic-users.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: A place on Arcavios where witchstalkers swarm the Eradia.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: A plane (Echoverse version) where witchstalkers appear as multicephalic wolves.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A plane where witchstalkers attack magical beings and ignore all others.

entities.name: Dunbarrow
entities.description: A region of moors and forests on Eldraine where witchstalkers often hunt.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane where wolves are a secondary creature type beside werewolves.

entities.name: Kessig Wolf Run
entities.description: The homeland of wolves and werewolves on Innistrad.

entities.name: Howlpack Alpha
entities.description: A Wolf Lord on Innistrad.

entities.name: Immerwolf
entities.description: A Wolf Lord on Innistrad.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Released from the Helvault, she cast the cursemute spell that let werewolves fuse their human and wolf spirits.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The artifact from which Avacyn was released.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: A spell cast by Avacyn that let werewolves fuse human and wolf spirits into a permanent wolf form, and which also stifled Garruk's curse for a while.

entities.name: Wolfir
entities.description: Humanoid wolves created by the cursemute, who were allies of Avacyn.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker whose curse was stifled for a while by the cursemute.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane whose wolves were unusually long-lived and wise, and were compleated; the page notes it is now New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Rot Wolf
entities.description: An example of the last wolves of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane where the Selesnya Conclave's Ledev Wolf-riders raise wolf pups as mounts.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose Ledev Wolf-riders guard the Great Concourse.

entities.name: Ledev Wolf-riders
entities.description: Selesnya riders who each raise a wolf pup from birth to serve as a mount.

entities.name: Voja
entities.description: A notable Ravnican wolf raised by Tolsimir Wolfblood.

entities.name: Tolsimir Wolfblood
entities.description: Raised the wolf Voja.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: A plane where the Heart Wolf is native.

entities.name: Heart Wolf
entities.description: A wolf native to Ulgrotha, the standard riding mount of goblin sub-chiefs, dignitaries, ambassadors and dwarven traders.

events.summary: After being released from the Helvault, Avacyn casts the cursemute, letting werewolves choose to fuse their human and wolf spirits into a permanent wolf form.
events.quote: After Avacyn was released from the Helvault , she cast a spell that granted the werewolves a choice to either remain a werewolf

events.summary: The cursemute also stifles Garruk's curse for a while.
events.quote: This spell is called the cursemute , and also stifled Garruk 's curse for a while.

events.summary: The last wolves of Mirrodin are compleated, as the plane becomes New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Like all Mirran animals, they were compleated

relations.note: The wolfir were allies of Avacyn.
relations.quote: These humanoid wolves became known as wolfir , and were allies of Avacyn.
A notable one of these is Voja , who was raised by Tolsimir Wolfblood .

relations.note: The Ledev Wolf-riders belong to the Selesnya Conclave.
relations.quote: The Ledev Wolf-riders of the Selesnya Conclave begin their apprenticeship at a young age.
The Kessig Wolf Run is the homeland of Wolves and Werewolves alike.
